annotations.title: Check an EU EORI customs number (paid)

description: EORI number validation for customs, logistics, import/export and e-commerce agents, live from the European Commission's EORI validation service: registered and valid or not, and the trader's name and address when the trader agreed to publish them. All EU member states (GB numbers are not covered). Costs 0.003 USDC via x402, or 2 credits of a Factline API key.
